CustomField.formula: IF( (LimitsApexCursorsUsed__c / LimitsApexCursorsMax__c * 100) >= 90, "⛔", IF( (LimitsApexCursorsUsed__c / LimitsApexCursorsMax__c * 100) < 90 && (LimitsApexCursorsUsed__c / LimitsApexCursorsMax__c * 100) >= 80, "⚠️", "✅" ) ) + ' ' + IF(LimitsApexCursorsMax__c = 0, '100', TEXT(ROUND(LimitsApexCursorsUsed__c / LimitsApexCursorsMax__c * 100, 2))) + '% (' + TEXT(LimitsApexCursorsUsed__c) + ' / ' + TEXT(LimitsApexCursorsMax__c) + ')'
CustomField.inlineHelpText: ✅ when 80% or less of the limit is used, ⚠️ when 80.1-89.9% is used, or ⛔ when 90% or more is used
CustomField.label: Apex Cursors
